The Shootout

Tucson, AZ · University of Arizona

The Shootout is a road group ride in Tucson, AZ. It meets every Saturday morning; start varies 6:00–7:30 am by season, starting at University Blvd & Euclid Ave. Expect about 70 miles, A 22–28+ mph; Scootout 19–23 mph; Old-Old Man 16–20 mph.

About the The Shootout group ride

Tucson's famous fast Saturday road ride. Three groups leave a few minutes apart on the same route south of town. It is self-supported and riders separate by pace. Not a beginner ride. The 16–20 mph group is the friendliest option.
